TX.why: Units 11, 12 and 14 ran 21,400 miles in Texas, the 180 on a Pecos County ranch road included: Texas exempts no off-highway or private road miles. Total fuel 7,880 gal (every gallon into the three tractors, the 95-gallon cash fill and the 120 gallons bought in Mexico included) over total miles 49,010 (the Mexico miles included) is 6.22 mpg; 21,400 / 6.22 = 3,441 taxable gallons. Tax-paid 4,120 gal on the card, the paper receipt R-3318 for FC-0817 counted once. Net -679 gal at $0.20: a credit of $135.80. Valued at the $824 of Texas tax already paid at the pump that the line credits

NM.why: 9,850 miles; 9,850 / 6.22 = 1,584 taxable gallons; tax-paid 1,050 gal; net 534 gal at $0.21: $112.14. Valued at the $220.50 of New Mexico tax paid at the pump that the line credits

CO.why: 11,200 miles; 11,200 / 6.22 = 1,801 taxable gallons; tax-paid 1,595 gal on the card. The 95-gallon cash fill at Walsenburg has a slip with no seller, no address, no unit and no purchaser, so it earns no credit (P550.300) though it counts in total fuel. Net 206 gal at $0.335: $69.01. Valued at the $534.33 of Colorado tax paid at the pump that the line credits

WY.why: 6,300 miles in Wyoming, of which 420 on private oil-lease roads that Wyoming exempts as off-highway and private roads not publicly maintained: taxable 5,880; 5,880 / 6.22 = 945 taxable gallons; tax-paid 900 gal; net 45 gal at $0.24: $10.80. Valued at the $216 of Wyoming tax paid at the pump that the line credits

traps.MX: Chihuahua, Mexico is not an IFTA member: its 260 miles and 120 gallons go into the totals, and there is no line for it
traps.OK: Only the pickup P-2, two axles and 10,000 lb, went to Oklahoma: it is not a qualified motor vehicle, so no line
traps.LA: Only box truck 9, two axles and 25,500 lb, not used in combination, went to Louisiana: it is not a qualified motor vehicle (over 26,000 lb is the line), so no line
traps.KS: Load K-5521 was brokered to Wrenfield Freight, which ran it under its own IFTA licence; no Brackmoor unit entered Kansas
